visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with several young children riding balance bikes and scooters on a mock road surface in an outdoor park. A boy in a dark blue sweatshirt and a girl in a pink sweater are prominent in the foreground, paused at a yellow-and-white painted mock pedestrian crossing while other children move in the background. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up shot of a colorful informational map titled 'Tainan Municipal Transportation Park,' showing various simulated road paths and park features. The background includes green trees and a modern residential building, indicating an urban recreational setting with clear, bright daylight. (3) A young boy in a blue shirt pedals his balance bike down a gray paved path lined with tall, slender trees and white concrete benches. Following him is a young girl with long black hair, wearing a pink shirt with a cartoon character on the back, also riding a small balance vehicle. (4) The kids arrive at a miniature mock intersection equipped with functional small-scale traffic lights showing red. Several children wait on their bikes and scooters at the white stop lines, while adults stand nearby watching. The ground features realistic road markings like arrows and zebra crossings. (5) A young girl in a pink top is seen from behind, riding her scooter along a curved gray path bordered by yellow and black striped safety poles. The camera follows her movement as she navigates the turn, with urban apartment buildings and parked cars visible in the distance. (6) A wider shot shows the mock intersection where a green traffic light is visible, and multiple children are actively riding across the zebra crossing and down various lanes. The environment is bustling with activity, yet organized like a real roadway, under a slightly overcast but bright sky. (7) A close-up focus returns to the boy in the blue shirt and the girl in the pink sweater as they prepare to move from the zebra crossing area. The boy looks toward the camera while steadying his bike, and the girl sits ready on her three-wheeled balance bike. (8) The camera pans across a section of the track featuring blue painted lanes with white arrows and a 'START' mark. A young girl in pink rides her scooter through the curve, while the background reveals a red playground structure with a yellow slide and some greenery. (9) An adult male wearing a dark jacket, mask, and holding a water bottle walks alongside the boy in blue as he rides his bike, demonstrating parental supervision. They are on a narrow paved path next to a grass verge and some shrubbery near the park's edge. (10) The final shots show a boy riding his bike toward a 'START' line on the pavement, and a girl in pink navigating a curved path. The background features parked blue and black cars along a street, emphasizing the park's location within a residential neighborhood.
